summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Zendesk integration for BridgeBot. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verification confirmed all Zendesk components are working correctly including settings page, navigation, and platform filters.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tests use existing instance data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zendesk integration fully tested. Backend endpoints: GET /api/admin/zendesk-config (returns default config with connected=false, agent_assist_enabled=true when no config exists), PUT /api/admin/zendesk-config (validates credentials against Zendesk API, returns 400 for incomplete/invalid credentials), DELETE /api/admin/zendesk-config (returns success even when no config exists), POST /api/admin/zendesk-config/test (returns 400 when no config saved), POST /api/zendesk/webhook/{instance_id}/{secret} (returns 403 for wrong secret, requires ticket_id in payload), GET /api/zendesk/suggestion/{instance_id}/{ticket_id} (returns null suggestion for non-existent tickets), GET /api/admin/zendesk-tickets (returns empty list when no tickets processed). Analytics endpoints /api/analytics/overview and /api/analytics/daily-by-platform both include zendesk count field. Frontend: Zendesk nav item appears in sidebar between Telegram and Knowledge Base, ZendeskSettings page has Connection card with subdomain input (.zendesk.com suffix), email input, token input, Connect button disabled when fields empty. Conversations page has Zendesk filter button alongside Web, Discord, Telegram, API. Dashboard shows Zendesk platform card and trend chart includes Zendesk in legend.
